intro: Let scripts on this computer start work on an agent with the pasabot run command or the local API. Each agent has its own switch and tokens. Tokens act at Standard trust at most, so anything risky still asks you first.

form.title: New token for {{name}}
form.label: Token name
form.labelHint: Where it will be used, e.g. "laptop scripts".
form.remote: Also allow from other devices (not just this computer)
form.remoteHint: Leave off unless a script on another machine needs it. Browser pages can never use a token.

created.title: Copy this token now
created.body: It is shown only once. Keep it somewhere safe, like a password manager.
